newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney cuts Kellogg EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Smith Barney cuts Kellogg EPS.

text.p: -- Smith Barney analyst David Rabinowitz said Thursday he cut his 1996 earnings estimate for Kellogg Co to $3.05 a share from $3.20 and his 1997 estimate to $3.35 a share from $3.50.
-- His rating on Kellogg remains neutral.

-- On September 4, Kellogg said its third quarter earnings will be about 20 percent below the $1.05 a share it earned a year ago and its full-year 1996 earnings would be below the $3.48 it earned in 1995.
-- The cereal company blamed competitive promotions in the U.S. market.
-- Kellogg said it expects earnings will grow the fourth quarter. But Rabinowitz said he believes it will take longer for Kellogg to see a turnaround.
-- Kellogg shares were down 1-1/4 at 67-1/4 on the New York Stock Exchange, after setting a new low of 65-5/8. The stock was up 1-1/4 at 67-1/4 in composite trading.
